li.label: First Spark
li.description: Retains the chosen Thunder evolution. Refinement: bonus damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Branching Current
li.description: Every three eligible ordinary hits arc for 75 damage to up to two other enemies within 6 cells of the target. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Piercing Charge
li.description: Three consecutive ordinary hits against the same enemy, with no more than 5 seconds between hits, add a 100-damage lightning strike. Changing targets resets the sequence. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Stormstep
li.description: Move at least 3 cells between eligible ordinary hits to add 75 lightning damage on the next hit. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Storm Reservoir
li.description: Actual shield absorption stores up to 10 charge on this map, without a time limit. At 10 charge, your next ordinary hit consumes it to strike for 100 extra damage. After discharge, charging and discharge pause for 4 seconds. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Conductive Trace
li.description: Enemies hit by Branching Current retain a trace for 4 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on a traced enemy consumes it for 50 extra damage. Cooldown: 4 seconds per enemy. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Open Circuit
li.description: Piercing Charge leaves an opening for 4 seconds. Hit that enemy with your learned Thunder ability to consume it and recover 10% of the remaining ability cooldown, up to 2 seconds. Once per cast. Refinement: opening duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Storm Footprint
li.description: Stormstep leaves a footprint at your attack position for 4 seconds. After moving at least 3 cells away, your next ordinary hit detonates it for 50 damage to up to 16 enemies within 2 cells. Only your most recent footprint is kept. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Residual Charge
li.description: A successful Storm Reservoir discharge grants an independent 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Absorption by this tree's own shields cannot recharge its reservoir. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Twin Feed
li.description: Each Branching Current that actually damages two different enemies completes one circuit. After two circuits, the next Branching Current sends a 75-damage strike to the farthest other enemy within 8 cells of its first arc victim. The release does not count toward the next circuit. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Four-way Grid
li.description: A successful Twin Feed strike leaves two contacts at its endpoints for 4 seconds. Your next ordinary hit within 2 cells of one contact consumes the pair and pulses the other contact for 50 damage to up to two enemies within 2 cells. Only the latest pair remains; a hit with no enemy at the opposite contact does not spend it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Live Fence
li.description: When your ordinary attack consumes Conductive Trace, connect that impact position to the nearest different enemy within 8 cells that already bears a trace from your own tree. The fixed wire lasts 4 seconds and strikes each of the first 16 different enemies that walks across it once for 75 damage. It does not follow its endpoints, consume the other trace, or trigger on teleportation. Creating a wire has a 6-second recovery; without a second valid trace, only the normal trace damage occurs. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Storm Enclosure
li.description: If the same Live Fence actually damages two different enemies, prepare one enclosure. Your next cast of learned Thunder replaces that wire with a triangular boundary based on its saved endpoints for 3 seconds. It opens toward the caster when space allows. The first 16 different enemies crossing any of its three edges receive one 75-damage strike each; all edges share that limit. Preparation survives wire expiry, but holds only one enclosure, and one wire can prepare it only once. The triangle has its own crossing budget and cannot prepare another enclosure. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Lightning Needle
li.description: Consume Conductive Traces on two different enemies consecutively to place a needle at the second target for 5 seconds. An actual hit from your learned Thunder ability within 6 cells of the needle consumes it, striking one other enemy within 6 cells for 100 damage. Only the latest needle remains; without another enemy it is not spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Storm Anchor
li.description: After Lightning Needle deals damage, its charged anchor remains for 3 seconds. While at least 4 cells away, your next ordinary hit pulls it one grid step toward you, dealing 75 damage to the closest enemy within 1 cell of that short path. This consumes the anchor; without a path target it remains. Only the latest charged anchor remains. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Relay Port
li.description: After Branching Current deals damage, the nearest other free colonist within 6 cells receives a relay port for 4 seconds. Their first ordinary hit on an enemy carrying your Conductive Trace consumes the port and gives each of you an independent 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Your trace remains yours to spend. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Paired Circuit
li.description: After Relay Port is completed, you have 3 seconds to land an ordinary hit on a different enemy. This consumes the opportunity, dealing 50 damage to one enemy within 2 cells of the ally’s saved impact and one near your new impact. It hits at most two different enemies; no target means the opportunity remains. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Pinpoint Lock
li.description: While your Open Circuit mark remains, every two further consecutive ordinary hits on that enemy extend it by 1 second, at most twice. Changing enemies resets partial progress. Spending a fully extended opening with your learned Thunder ability adds 75 lightning damage. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Heartpiercer
li.description: Spending a fully extended opening prepares one Heartpiercer. Your next actual Piercing Charge consumes it, striking the nearest other enemy up to 3 cells behind the target for 100 damage. The corridor is 1.5 cells wide. It cannot store multiple charges; no aligned enemy means the opportunity is spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Circuit Breaker
li.description: Piercing Charge marks its victim for 4 seconds. Moving at least 2 cells from the marked position discharges it for 75 damage, once. Up to four enemies can be marked; a new mark replaces the oldest when full. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Pursuing Current
li.description: A successful Circuit Breaker discharge leaves a pursuit mark for 3 seconds. Your learned Thunder ability can consume it on hit to mark one other enemy within 6 cells. That enemy takes 75 damage once it moves 2 cells within 4 seconds. The transferred mark cannot relay again. Up to four transferred marks can remain; the oldest is replaced when full. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Delayed Pole
li.description: When Open Circuit consumes an opening, a lightning pulse strikes that position after 1.5 seconds for 75 damage to up to 16 enemies within 2 cells. The pulse stays at the original position. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Double Beat
li.description: Before Delayed Pole lands, hit a different enemy with an ordinary attack to add a second pulse at that hit position. It lands 0.5 seconds after the first pulse and deals 50 damage within 2 cells, to up to 16 enemies. Once per opening. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Risk Voltage
li.description: Below 60% health, consuming Open Circuit triggers your chosen mode: 75 extra damage to that enemy, or repair up to 40 points of your own non-permanent injuries. Default: damage. Change mode outside combat through Combat choices in the personal progression panel. Both modes share a 10-second recovery; changing mode does not reset it. Only an actual benefit opens the crown response window. Refinement: bonus damage and healing. Base rewards: damage 75; healing 40. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; healing ×10.

li.label: Critical Discharge
li.description: After Risk Voltage actually deals damage or repairs an injury, absorb enemy damage with a shield from outside this tree or suffer enemy damage within 3 seconds to prepare Critical Discharge. Your next actual Piercing Charge consumes that preparation for one extra 100-damage strike. Hold at most one; preparation survives the response window on this map. Self-harm, friendly fire, expired shields and this tree's own shields do not count. Releasing the strike closes that response window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Return Current
li.description: Leave more than 1 cell from your Storm Footprint, then return within 1 cell before it expires to prepare Return Current. Your next actual Stormstep releases 75 damage at the original footprint target if it is still standing and hostile on this map. The prepared return survives footprint expiry, but holds only one target; each footprint can prepare it once. Returning does not consume the footprint or bypass the normal Stormstep recovery. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Storm Circuit
li.description: After Return Current deals damage from two different footprints, the following Stormstep leaves a radius-3 ring at your attack position for 3 seconds. The first 3 different enemies that walk across its boundary receive one 75-damage strike each. Entering and leaving use the same per-enemy limit; standing inside or teleporting across does not trigger it. The second completing hit prepares the ring for a later Stormstep, and the ring release does not bank another completed return. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Corner Cutter
li.description: When Stormstep deals damage, the nearest enemy within 1 cell of the segment between your previous ordinary-hit position and your current position takes 50 extra lightning damage. This cannot strike the main target. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Zigzag Storm
li.description: Three Stormsteps with each successive direction changing by at least 45 degrees prepare a bend. The next Corner Cutter that hits an enemy may turn once to another enemy within 6 cells for 75 damage, excluding its victim and the original main target. With no second enemy the bend remains ready. Only one bend can be stored. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Moving Conductor
li.description: After Stormstep deals damage, the nearest other free colonist within 5 cells receives a conductor for 3 seconds. Moving at least 2 cells from where it was received, then landing an ordinary hit, consumes it and gives you an independent 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Crossing Current
li.description: After your ally completes Moving Conductor, you have 5 seconds to trigger Stormstep within 2 cells of where they received it. This consumes the opportunity and strikes up to two different enemies within 5 cells of you for 50 damage each. If there are no nearby enemies, the opportunity remains. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Stillness Coil
li.description: After Stormstep deals damage, remain in the same cell for 1.5 seconds. Your next ordinary hit consumes the preparation for 75 extra lightning damage. Moving to another cell or leaving the map cancels it, including after it becomes ready. Only one preparation is kept; the extra strike does not trigger another Stormstep. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Eye of the Storm
li.description: When Stillness Coil deals damage, it leaves a 3-cell static circle at your position for 3 seconds. Leave the circle, then deal damage to an enemy inside it with your learned Thunder ability to consume the circle. You gain an independent 75-point shield for 3 seconds; the nearest other free colonist within 6 cells also receives one if present. Only the newest circle is kept. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Recoil Current
li.description: When enemy damage absorbed by outside shields fills Storm Reservoir to 10, a 3-second counter window opens. Absorb another enemy hit with an outside shield during that window to prepare 75 extra damage for your next reservoir discharge. The filling hit cannot count twice; surplus absorption never refreshes the window. You may discharge normally before preparing the counter. Prepared damage stays with the stored charge on this map. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Retaliation Storm
li.description: If the enhanced Recoil Current actually damages the enemy whose hit filled your reservoir, arc 75 damage to one other enemy within 6 cells of that target. Hitting another enemy still releases the normal counter bonus, but grants no arc. If no secondary enemy is available, no delayed arc is stored. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Split Reservoir
li.description: Residual Charge is shared with the nearest standing colonist within 5 cells: 25 shield each for 3 seconds, replacing the normal 2-point self shield. If both new shields are fully absorbed by enemy attacks before expiry, your next reservoir discharge deals 75 extra damage. No ally means the normal self shield. Expiry and spending shields do not count; only one bonus can be held. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75; shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Resonant Guard
li.description: After both Split Reservoir shields are fully absorbed by enemy attacks, your next cast of the learned Thunder ability grants you and that partner 75 shield each for 3 seconds. A hit is not required. Only one cast reward can be held. If the original partner is no longer a living friendly colonist on your map, you alone receive the shield. These shields cannot prepare another split reward. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Grounding Rod
li.description: With a full Storm Reservoir, casting learned Thunder stores its 10 charge in a grounding rod at your feet for 4 seconds, sharing the normal 4-second discharge recovery. Move at least 3 cells away, then land an ordinary attack before expiry to release 75 damage to up to 2 enemies within 4 cells of the enemy whose hit filled the reservoir. That enemy must still be standing and hostile on this map. Storing replaces the normal discharge; it is not refunded on expiry. No separate interaction is needed. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75; shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Field Commutator
li.description: After moving at least 3 cells away from a charged grounding rod, you may walk back onto its original cell before firing it and before its original expiry. This consumes the rod for a 3-point shield lasting 3 seconds instead of its damage. Teleporting onto it does not activate this return. Firing and returning spend the same rod, so each charge grants only one of these rewards. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Rescue Spark
li.description: With 10 Storm Reservoir charge, restoring health to another injured free colonist within 5 cells consumes the charge to attempt 3 extra healing. It shares the reservoir discharge’s 4-second recovery; ordinary attacks can still spend the same charge first. No charge is spent if the original healing already repairs all eligible wounds. Requires an existing healing effect; does not grant a healing ability. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 60. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Survival Circuit
li.description: When Rescue Spark actually repairs a wound, keep a Survival Link to that patient for 4 seconds. Your next absorption of enemy damage by a shield from outside this tree consumes the link and grants that patient an independent 100-point shield for 4 seconds. The patient must remain a living, friendly free colonist on your map. Only the newest link is kept; healing that repairs nothing does not create one. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 100. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: First Flame
li.description: Retains the chosen Flame evolution. Refinement: spreading burn damage or the extra detonation bonus. Consumed burn damage is returned in full. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Firebrand
li.description: Three ordinary hits within 6 seconds brand the last victim for 6 seconds, keeping at most two brands. Your next ordinary hit on that victim spends the brand for 50 extra damage. Brand generation has a 3-second cooldown; bonus damage cannot brand again. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Furnace Heart
li.description: Every two ordinary hits store one heat, at most once per 0.5 seconds. Store up to three; heat expires after 10 seconds without renewal. At full heat, the next ordinary hit spends three for 75 extra damage. Venting starts a 3-second cooldown that pauses heat generation. Bonus damage never generates heat. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Chasing Flame
li.description: A real Firebrand bonus hit leaves a 6-second tinder mark on its victim. Your Flame ability hit spends it for 75 extra damage. Keep up to two tinder marks; one-second cooldown per victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Flying Cinders
li.description: A real Firebrand bonus hit splashes 50 damage to another enemy within 3 cells of its victim, with a 2-second cooldown. No available secondary target means no splash cooldown is spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Furnace Vent
li.description: A real Furnace Heart vent splashes 50 damage each to up to two other enemies within 3 cells, with a 3-second cooldown. Splash damage generates no heat. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Bank the Fire
li.description: A real Furnace Heart vent grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, with a 3-second cooldown. This layer refreshes to its budget rather than adding to its remainder, and cannot generate heat. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Falling Embers
li.description: A real Chasing Flame bonus plants a cinder at the impact cell. After 1.5 seconds it deals 50 damage each to at most two enemies within 2 cells, with a 3-second cooldown. The cinder stays on the ground. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Passing Fire
li.description: Victims actually hit by Flying Cinders carry embers for 4 seconds. Your ordinary hit spends an ember for 50 extra damage. Remember up to two victims, with a one-second cooldown per victim. Embers cannot create Firebrand or Flying Cinders. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cinder Bed
li.description: When one Furnace Vent damages two distinct secondary victims, leave a 3-second cinder bed at the original primary target cell. Your ordinary hit on an enemy within 2 cells spends it for 75 extra damage, once per bed. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Returning Heat
li.description: When Bank the Fire actually absorbs hostile damage, remember the attacker for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on it returns up to 50 damage, never more than that hit’s actual absorption, and spends the record. Only the latest absorption is remembered. Other shields do not fuel this effect. Refinement: counter-damage cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Draw to the Fire
li.description: Before Falling Embers erupts, move from within 3 cells of its cinder to outside that radius. Your next ordinary hit detonates the same cinder early, retaining its area, targets and single payout. Refinement: early detonation damage. Natural detonation is unchanged, and no new cinder is created. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Kindle Again
li.description: When Falling Embers damages an enemy, remember it for 3 seconds, keeping at most two victims. A later Flame ability hit on it spends the record for a 50-damage burst within 1.5 cells at its current position, hitting at most two enemies. This makes no new cinder. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Converging Flames
li.description: Spend Passing Fire embers on two different enemies within 3 seconds to hold Converging Flames for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit spends it for 75 extra damage on its victim. Another pair of target switches is needed to prepare it again. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Borrowed Flame
li.description: A real Passing Fire bonus heals up to 40 non-permanent injury on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells, with a 4-second cooldown. No injured recipient means no cooldown is spent. Healing creates no embers. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 40. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Sealed Furnace
li.description: While a cinder bed exists, the vent cooldown still blocks venting but no longer pauses heat generation. Switch targets to rebuild at least one heat and extend that bed by 2 seconds once. Spending the extended bed uses one extra heat to add 25 base damage, refined independently of the bed itself. Without enough heat, only the bed damage is paid. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Walk the Coals
li.description: After spending a cinder bed, remember your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least 3 cells away from that position and hit a different enemy to grant 2-point, 3-second shields to up to two allied colonists within 2 cells of the old bed. One payout, consumed even if no ally remains nearby; allies need no interaction. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Stoke the Pressure
li.description: After Returning Heat deals bonus damage, remember that enemy for 3 seconds. Another ordinary hit spends the record to delay its current ordinary weapon warmup by 0.5 seconds. Only a recognized weapon warmup is affected; airborne projectiles and special boss timers are unchanged. Without an eligible warmup, retain the record until expiry. Only the latest enemy is remembered. Repeated node trials increase the delay from 0.5 seconds toward 0.595 seconds with diminishing returns, rounded to the nearest game tick. The three-second mark window and one-use rule remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.

li.label: Shared Warmth
li.description: After Returning Heat deals bonus damage, grant half of its actual damage as a shield, up to 2 points for 3 seconds, to the nearest other colonist within 4 cells. Repeated grants refresh this layer rather than adding to its remainder. No ally means no shield. This shield cannot trigger Returning Heat. Refinement: shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Blood Pact
li.description: Retains the chosen Blood evolution. Refinement: overheal-to-shield conversion or kill healing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.

li.label: Drink from the Blade
li.description: While you have treatable injuries, three ordinary hits heal up to 20 non-permanent injury points on you. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A gap of 4 seconds between eligible hits resets progress. Full health, permanent scars alone and bonus damage do not build progress. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Share the Blood
li.description: An ordinary hit heals up to 20 non-permanent injury points on the other allied colonist with the most treatable injury severity within 4 cells. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Ties prefer the nearer ally. Scars are excluded; no eligible patient means no cooldown. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Wetted Edge
li.description: Real healing from Drink from the Blade prepares one 3-second opportunity: your next ordinary hit deals 50 extra damage. It neither stacks nor refreshes, and the hit that healed you cannot consume it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Held Blood
li.description: Real healing from Drink from the Blade stores one charge for 4 seconds, capped at one; further healing does not refresh it. Casting your Blood ability spends it for a 2-point self shield lasting 3 seconds. Healing attempts without recovery store nothing. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Keep the Pulse
li.description: After Share the Blood actually heals, remember that patient for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on a different enemy grants the patient a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per healing event. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Stay Close
li.description: After Share the Blood heals, walk at least two native steps and land an ordinary hit while within 2 cells of that patient to heal up to 20 more non-permanent injury point. The window lasts 3 seconds; teleporting does not count, and full health preserves only the original window. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Blood Trace
li.description: A real Wetted Edge hit leaves a 4-second blood trace on up to two enemies. Your Blood ability hit consumes it for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Refinement: trace bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Returning Tide
li.description: When a Held Blood shield absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. A close ordinary hit within 2 cells deals 50 extra damage once per shield round. Later blocks do not extend the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Give Back
li.description: After a Keep the Pulse shield absorbs enemy damage, your next ordinary hit within 3 seconds heals up to 20 injury points on another injured ally within 4 cells, excluding that shield’s patient. Once per shield round; without another patient, only the original window remains. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Hold the Wound
li.description: If a patient remains below 50% native total health after Stay Close’s follow-up actually heals, grant them a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Once per follow-up; check health after healing. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Change Blades
li.description: After your Blood ability consumes a trace and deals real bonus damage, an ordinary hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds heals you for up to 20 injury points. One opportunity per cast, without repeated renewal. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Reclaim Blood
li.description: Real Blood Trace damage heals you for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. If healing occurs, also grant a 25-point shield for 3 seconds. Once per ability cast. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Full health grants no healing. Base rewards: shield 25; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.

li.label: Step into the Tide
li.description: After Returning Tide deals real damage, remember your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least two steps and move 2 cells away, then land a close ordinary hit on another enemy for 50 extra damage, once per return. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Lingering Warmth
li.description: After Returning Tide deals real damage, grant a 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the nearest other allied colonist within 4 cells. If none is nearby, heal yourself for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. No delayed payout is stored. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Full health grants no healing. Base rewards: shield 50; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.

li.label: The Pulse Returns
li.description: After Give Back actually heals a different ally, grant the original Keep the Pulse patient a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. This new shield cannot restart Give Back. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Move Together
li.description: After Give Back heals, remember the new patient’s position for 3 seconds. Walk within 2 cells of it and land an ordinary hit to grant you and that patient separate 25-point shields for 3 seconds, once per Give Back. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Hold On
li.description: When Hold the Wound’s shield actually absorbs enemy damage, your next ordinary hit within 2 cells may heal its patient for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. Once within 3 seconds; later blocks do not extend the window. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Relieve the Guard
li.description: After Hold the Wound grants its shield, remember the patient’s position for 3 seconds. Walk outside its 2-cell radius and land a close hit on a different enemy to heal another injured ally within 4 cells for up to 20 injury points, excluding the original patient. Once per round. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Firm Footing
li.description: Retains the chosen Giant evolution. Refinement: burst damage or stationary shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.

li.label: Breach the Line
li.description: Three ordinary hits against enemies within 2 cells, accumulated within 4 seconds, add 50 damage to the third victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Distant hits and bonus damage do not count; weapon type and racial body size are unrestricted. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Brace
li.description: An ordinary hit against an enemy within 2 cells grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds. This layer does not stack with itself, bonus damage cannot trigger it, and racial body size is unrestricted. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Press the Advance
li.description: A real Breach the Line bonus leaves a 4-second pressure mark, keeping at most two. Your Earthshatter hit consumes it for 75 extra damage, at most once per second on each victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shoulder Through
li.description: A real Breach the Line bonus hits one other enemy within 2 cells for 50 damage. Cooldown: 3 seconds; no secondary target means no cooldown is spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Answer the Blow
li.description: After your Brace layer absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on that enemy within 2 cells returns the absorbed amount as damage, up to 2. One payment; absorbed hits do not accumulate. Refinement: retaliation cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shoulder to Shoulder
li.description: Casting Earthshatter grants 50-point shields for 3 seconds to up to two other colonists within 3 cells, with a 6-second cooldown. No ally means no shield; Earthshatter cooldown is unchanged. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Open Seam
li.description: Earthshatter spending a pressure mark leaves a 3-second seam on that victim, up to two. Your next ordinary hit within 2 cells spends the seam for 75 extra damage without creating pressure. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Fault Line
li.description: A real Shoulder Through splash records both impact cells for 4 seconds. Walk to a position at least 2 cells from their connecting segment, then spend the fault with an ordinary hit within 2 cells. Each endpoint deals 50 damage to at most one enemy within 1.5 cells. No victim is hit twice; empty ground still spends the fault. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Hold Formation
li.description: Complete two Answer the Blow returns against different attackers within 8 seconds to hold formation for 4 seconds. Your next Earthshatter cast spends it for a 3-point, 4-second personal shield. Repeating one attacker does not prepare it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Close Ranks
li.description: After Shoulder to Shoulder absorbs enemy damage, remember the first protected ally for 4 seconds. Walk within 2 cells of them and land an ordinary hit to heal up to 40 non-permanent injury, once per cast. No treatable injury preserves the opportunity; repeated absorption never extends its deadline. A new cast replaces the previous opportunity. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Base rewards: healing 40. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Pin the Shot
li.description: Spending a seam delays its victim’s current ordinary weapon warmup by 0.5 seconds, if eligible. Airborne projectiles and special boss timers are unchanged; once per seam. Refinement: weapon warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.

li.label: Seize the Opening
li.description: After a seam deals real damage, heal up to 20 non-permanent injury on yourself. Actual healing records your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least 2 cells and finish at least 2 cells from that position, then hit an enemy within 2 cells for one more heal of up to 20. No treatable injury preserves the opportunity without extending its deadline. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Converging Faults
li.description: When both ends of one fault deal damage to different enemies, hold Converging Faults for 3 seconds. Your next Earthshatter hit spends it for 50 damage to up to two enemies within 1.5 cells of the impact cell. Only one charge is held, without stacking or renewal; different faults cannot complete a pair. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cover the Ground
li.description: After a fault deals real damage, grant 50-point shields for 3 seconds to up to two allied colonists within 2 cells of its original midpoint. The area follows neither caster nor victims; once per fault. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Returning Weight
li.description: After a Hold Formation shield absorbs enemy damage, hold a return for 3 seconds. A close ordinary hit against its latest attacker spends it for 50 extra damage and reduces remaining Earthshatter cooldown by 1 second. Once per formation shield; later blocks update the attacker without extending the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Share the Wall
li.description: When Earthshatter spends Hold Formation, replace its 3-point shield with separate 50-point shields on you and the nearest other colonist within 3 cells, lasting 4 seconds. Without an ally, keep the original 3-point shield. Existing shield remainder is never copied. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Turn the Line
li.description: After Close Ranks heals an ally, remember their position for 3 seconds. Walk outside that position’s 2-cell radius and land a close ordinary hit on a different enemy to grant that ally a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. No ally interaction is needed. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Stand Together
li.description: If an ally healed by Close Ranks remains below 50% total health, grant them a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. After it absorbs enemy damage, your next close ordinary hit may heal that ally for up to 20 non-permanent injury, once within 3 seconds. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.

li.label: First Frost
li.description: Retains the chosen Frost evolution. Refinement: its 39-point damage effect. Relic awakenings are unaffected. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Rime
li.description: Three ordinary hits mark the third hit’s victim with rime for 4 seconds, up to two victims. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A 4-second gap between eligible hits resets progress. Bonus damage and abilities do not count. Later branches spend rime; the mark itself adds no slow. Refinement gradually extends newly applied marks from 4 seconds toward 4.76 seconds, rounded to game ticks. Hit count, cooldown, target limit and one-use consumption remain unchanged; existing deadlines are preserved. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Ice Mantle
li.description: Casting your Frost ability grants a separate 50-point personal shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds. The layer does not stack with itself or alter ability cooldown. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Shatter
li.description: A Frost ability hit spends the victim’s rime mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. No mark means no bonus. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Freeze a Beat
li.description: An ordinary hit on a rimed enemy warming up an ordinary weapon attack spends rime to extend that warmup by 0.2 seconds, once per mark. No eligible warmup leaves the original mark deadline intact; no extra stun is added. The mark is still spent once. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.

li.label: Ice Edge
li.description: After Ice Mantle absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. Your ordinary hit within 2 cells returns the absorbed amount, up to 50 damage, once per shield round without renewal. A smaller absorbed budget is returned unchanged. The same shield round can still pay only once. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shared Cold
li.description: A real Ice Mantle grant opens a 3-second opportunity. An ordinary hit grants the nearest other colonist within 3 cells a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. No ally preserves only the original deadline. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Falling Splinters
li.description: Real Shatter damage remembers the target cell for 3 seconds. An ordinary hit on another enemy deals 50 damage to at most one enemy within 2 cells of that old cell, once per shatter. Empty ground still spends it. Only the latest Shatter landing is retained; charges do not stack. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cold Opening
li.description: After Freeze a Beat actually delays a warmup, remember the victim and your position for 3 seconds. Take a native walking step, then hit that victim ordinarily for 50 extra damage, once per successful delay. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Banked Cold
li.description: Complete Ice Edge returns against two different enemies within 40 seconds to store one charge for 40 seconds. Your next Frost cast spends it for a 75-point shield lasting 4 seconds. Repeating one victim neither builds it nor renews the counting window. Stored charges do not stack or renew. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Cold Link
li.description: After Shared Cold’s shield absorbs enemy damage, take at least one native walking step, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells of its original grant cell within 3 seconds to heal its patient by up to 20 non-permanent injury points, once per round. Patient movement does not move the circle; full health preserves only the original deadline, and teleporting does not count. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Scattered Ice
li.description: After Falling Splinters hits, walk 2 cells away from your recorded position and land a close ordinary hit on another victim within 3 seconds for 50 extra damage, once per round. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Splinter Mantle
li.description: After Falling Splinters hits, grant the nearest other colonist within 4 cells a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. With no ally, grant yourself 25 instead. Once per round. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Step the Crack
li.description: Real Cold Opening damage prepares one 3-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit on another enemy grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per opening without renewal. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Freeze Behind
li.description: After Cold Opening deals damage, walk back within 1 cell of the recorded pre-step position and land an ordinary hit within 3 seconds to heal up to 20 injury points on yourself. Once; teleporting does not count. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Cold Echo
li.description: After Banked Cold’s shield absorbs enemy damage, your next Frost ability hit within 40 seconds adds 50 damage to at most two enemies. One opportunity per shield round, without stacking. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cold Shared
li.description: When spending Banked Cold actually grants its shield, grant up to two other colonists within 3 cells separate 25-point shields for 3 seconds. A rejected primary grant provides nothing. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Mended Link
li.description: After Cold Link actually heals, grant its patient a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This new layer cannot restart Cold Link. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Change the Line
li.description: After Cold Link heals, walk outside 2 cells of the recorded patient position and land a close hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds. Heal another injured ally within 4 cells by up to 20 points, excluding the original patient, once per round. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Take the Edge
li.description: Retains the chosen Blade evolution. Refinement: its bonus damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Held Edge
li.description: Three ordinary hits within 2 cells on the same enemy leave an edge mark for 5 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A different eligible target or a 4-second gap resets the count. Distant hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: edge mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Crossed Blades
li.description: Ordinary hits within 2 cells on two different enemies within 4 seconds grant you a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Repeating the same target neither advances nor renews the count. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Closing Cut
li.description: A Blade ability hit spends the victim’s edge mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Later pulses add nothing without a new mark. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Feint
li.description: A close ordinary hit spends the enemy’s edge mark and records both positions for 3 seconds. Walk across the dividing line through the recorded target cell, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on that enemy for 50 extra damage. Standing on the line does not count; target movement does not shift it. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Once per edge mark; a new opportunity replaces the old one. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Back of the Blade
li.description: After Crossed Blades absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. An ordinary hit within 2 cells returns the latest hit’s absorbed amount, up to 50 damage, once per shield round. Later blocks replace the attacker and damage budget without extending the original 3-second window. Refinement: return-damage cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Blades Together
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Crossed Blades grants its shield, the next ordinary hit within 2 cells marks an enemy for 3 seconds. A different player colonist who lands an ordinary hit on that enemy gains a shield with a base amount of 1 for 3 seconds, once per round. The author cannot claim it. A new Crossed Blades grant replaces an unfinished round. Refinement: shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Returning Edge
li.description: Real Closing Cut damage opens a 4-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit within 2 cells on another enemy gives it a 5-second edge mark, once per round. Only one marked target is retained; the new mark replaces the old one without resetting Held Edge count or cooldown. Refinement: edge mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Flanking Edge
li.description: Real Feint damage remembers its enemy for 30 seconds. The next Blade ability hit on that enemy adds 50 damage and consumes the opportunity. Losing the target does not transfer the reward. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Fight On
li.description: Real Back of the Blade damage opens a 3-second opportunity. Walk at least one step, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on the original attacker to heal your non-permanent injuries once, with a base amount of 1 affected by healing modifiers. Full health preserves the original deadline without spending the opportunity. Teleporting cancels it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Pincer
li.description: After the ally shield from Blades Together actually absorbs enemy damage, a close ordinary hit by the author on the original marked enemy adds 50 damage within 3 seconds, once. Only that ally’s exact shield layer counts. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Guarded Return
li.description: When Closing Cut spends the mark transferred by Returning Edge and deals damage, grant yourself a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per transferred mark. Ordinary Held Edge marks do not qualify. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Passing Edge
li.description: After Closing Cut spends a transferred edge mark and deals damage, take at least two walking steps with a net displacement of 2 cells, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on another enemy within 3 seconds for 50 damage, once per mark. Passing Edge itself generates no new mark. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Pursuing Edge
li.description: Real Flanking Edge damage records its victim’s position for 3 seconds. Take a real walking step outside 2 cells of that position, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy for 50 damage, once. The original victim moving does not move the area. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Hidden Edge
li.description: After Flanking Edge deals damage, grant the nearest other colonist within 3 cells a shield with a base amount of 2 for 3 seconds. With no ally, grant yourself a base amount of 1 instead, once per round. Later pulses do not grant another shield. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Cover the Opening
li.description: After Fight On actually heals, grant yourself a separate shield with a base amount of 2 for 3 seconds, once per round. This layer cannot restart Back of the Blade. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Change Hands
li.description: Real Fight On healing opens a 3-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy heals the most injured other colonist within 4 cells once, with a base amount of 1 affected by healing modifiers. With no eligible patient, the original deadline is retained, not renewed. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Closing Pincer
li.description: After Pincer deals damage, grant its original Blades Together ally a new 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This layer cannot restart Pincer. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Change Wings
li.description: After Pincer deals damage, remember the original ally’s position for 3 seconds. Take a real walking step outside 2 cells of that fixed position, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy to heal the most injured other colonist within 4 cells, with a base amount of 1. Excludes yourself and the original ally; once per round. With no patient, retain the original deadline without spending the opportunity. Teleporting cancels it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Calibrate
li.description: Retains the chosen Sharpshooter evolution. Refinement: the extra distant-hit multiplier or piercing bonus damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Steady Aim
li.description: Three ordinary hits on the same enemy from at least 8 cells leave a sight mark for 5 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A different eligible target or a 4-second gap resets progress. Close hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Change the Line
li.description: Ordinary hits on two different enemies within 4 seconds from at least 8 cells mark the second for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Repeated hits neither advance nor renew progress; close hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Pierce the Gap
li.description: A Sharpshooter ability hit spends the victim’s sight mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. No further bonus is dealt without a new mark. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Suppress Aim
li.description: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a sight mark to delay the enemy’s current equipped-gun warmup by 0.3 seconds. Without a native gun warmup, keep the mark. Close hits, abilities and bonus damage do not spend it. Once per sight mark. Refinement: warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.

li.label: Step Back
li.description: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a line mark and records both positions for 4 seconds. Walk at least two steps, increasing distance from the recorded enemy cell by at least 2 cells, then hit that enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once per mark. Enemy movement does not move the reference cell; teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Relay Shot
li.description: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a line mark to open a 4-second relay. Another player colonist’s ordinary hit on that enemy triggers 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once per round. The author, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. A new relay replaces the author’s previous opportunity. Only actual bonus damage counts as a completed relay. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Lingering Line
li.description: Actual Pierce the Gap damage records its firing line for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on a different enemy from at least 8 cells deals 50 extra damage to the enemy nearest the old line within 1 cell, once, excluding the new trigger victim. Neither end follows movement. With no enemy near the line, keep the original deadline. Abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cut the Shot
li.description: Actually delaying a shot with Suppress Aim opens a 3-second opportunity. An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells on a different enemy warming up its equipped gun deals 50 extra damage, once. Without an eligible warmup, keep the remaining opportunity. A new Suppress Aim replaces it; abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Return Fire
li.description: Actual Step Back bonus damage opens a 4-second return opportunity. Walk at least one step to within 1 cell of the original firing position, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells to mend 20 points of your non-permanent injuries, once. With no eligible injury, keep the remaining opportunity. Teleporting cancels it; abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Covering Fire
li.description: Actual Relay Shot bonus damage grants its partner a 25-point shield for 3 seconds. Its first actual absorption of enemy damage gives the author 3 seconds to hit the original relay victim ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once per round. Other shields, abilities and bonus damage do not trigger it. An existing shield from this source on that partner retains its original budget and opportunity. The author keeps only the latest successfully granted cover opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage and shield strength. Base rewards: damage 50; shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.

li.label: Split the Line
li.description: Actual Lingering Line damage opens a 3-second split opportunity. Walk at least one step, move at least 1 cell from the trigger position and more than 1 cell from the old line, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Guard the Line
li.description: Actual Lingering Line damage grants a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the other eligible player colonist nearest the old line within 1 cell, once. Without an eligible ally, the author instead receives 25 shield point. Zero actual line damage grants no shield, and this shield cannot restart the line. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Break Their Rhythm
li.description: Actual Cut the Shot damage opens a 3-second follow-up. An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells on another enemy warming up its equipped gun delays that warmup by 0.3 seconds, once. Without an eligible warmup, keep the remaining opportunity. This delay cannot start a new Cut the Shot or follow-up. Refinement: warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.

li.label: Brace the Stock
li.description: Actual Cut the Shot damage grants the author a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. No shield is granted without actual cut damage. This shield cannot start relay or cover replies. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Take Position Again
li.description: Actual Return Fire healing opens a 3-second pursuit. Walk at least one step and at least 1 cell from the healing position, then hit the original Step Back enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, other victims, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Mutual Cover
li.description: Actual Return Fire healing opens a 3-second support opportunity. Hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells to heal 20 points on the other player colonist with the most non-permanent injury within 4 cells, once. The author and permanent injuries are excluded. Without an eligible patient, keep the original deadline. Abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Close the Gap
li.description: Actual Covering Fire reply damage grants its original relay partner a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This shield cannot reopen the cover reply. No shield is granted if the reply deals no actual damage. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Cross Cover
li.description: Actual Covering Fire reply damage records the author and original partner positions for 4 seconds. Walk at least two steps, move at least 2 cells from the start and increase distance from the recorded partner position by at least 2 cells, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells. The nearest third colonist within 4 cells receives a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once. The author and original partner are excluded. With no eligible recipient, keep the remaining opportunity; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Keep the Soul
li.description: Retains the chosen Soul evolution. Refinement: kill healing and every-third-hit Soul damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; healing ×10.

li.label: Gather Thought
li.description: Two ordinary hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds leave focus for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Switching victims or a 4-second gap resets progress; abilities and bonus damage do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Aftertone
li.description: An actual Soul ability hit leaves an aftertone for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Later pulses and hits during recovery neither renew nor move it. Other abilities, ordinary hits and bonus damage do not trigger it. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.

li.label: Soul Rend
li.description: A Soul ability hit spends the victim’s focus for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Later pulses add nothing without fresh focus. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Bind Thought
li.description: An ordinary hit spends existing focus to leave a fixed anchor at the impact cell for 4 seconds. A later actual Soul ability hit within 2 cells grants the author a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per anchor. No new anchor can be placed while one is pending or for 3 seconds after its shield grant. The anchor does not follow its victim. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Draw the Soul
li.description: An ordinary hit spends the victim’s aftertone to deal 50 extra damage to the nearest other enemy within 4 cells. With no second enemy, retain the mark without extending its expiry. Abilities and bonus damage cannot trigger it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Soul Offering
li.description: An ordinary hit spends the victim’s aftertone to mend up to 20 points of non-permanent injury on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells of the author. Scars are not healed. With no eligible patient, retain the mark without extending its expiry. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Fractured Echo
li.description: Actual Soul Rend damage records its impact cell for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on a different enemy releases one pulse there, dealing 50 damage each to at most 2 enemies within 2 cells, excluding the new trigger victim. An empty area retains the opportunity without extending it. The cell does not follow its original victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Return to the Circle
li.description: After the bound shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell and ordinarily hit that attacker within 1 cell of the fixed anchor, within 4 seconds, to mend up to 20 points of non-permanent injury. Once per shield. Teleporting cancels it. Scars are excluded; having no eligible wound retains the opportunity without extending it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Joined Voices
li.description: Actual Draw the Soul damage marks its victim for 4 seconds. The first other colonist to land an ordinary hit on it receives a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds. The target cannot reset while awaiting the relay or for 3 seconds after the shield grant. The author, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Return Passage
li.description: After Soul Offering actually heals, remember its patient for 4 seconds. A Soul ability hit on a different enemy from the healing trigger grants that original patient a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, if within 4 cells, once. Later pulses do not refill it; the passage cannot reset for 3 seconds after its shield grant. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Scattered Souls
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the pulse first deals actual damage, a Soul ability hit on a different enemy from its first victim sends bolts for 25 damage each to at most 2 other enemies within 3 cells of the new target, once per pulse. No secondary target retains the opportunity without extending it. Bolts cannot produce more bolts. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shelter in the Echo
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the pulse first deals actual damage, walk at least one cell, reach within 1 cell of its fixed impact area and ordinarily hit an enemy for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once per pulse. Teleporting cancels it; later hits neither refill nor extend the shield. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Leave the Circle
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Return to the Circle actually heals, walk at least one more cell, leave the anchor’s 1-cell area and ordinarily hit a different enemy for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, teleporting, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Rest for the Soul
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Return to the Circle actually heals, ordinarily hit a different enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 4 cells, once. Scars are excluded. With no patient, retain the opportunity without extending it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Answer the Call
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the partner’s Joined Voices shield first absorbs enemy damage, the author’s Soul ability hit on that attacker deals 50 extra soul damage, once per shield. Later absorption neither changes the attacker nor extends the opportunity. Ordinary hits and other abilities cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shared Vigil
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the partner’s Joined Voices shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell closer to that partner and ordinarily hit an enemy while within 2 cells for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels it. Later hits neither refill nor extend the shield; an absent original partner is never replaced. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Pursuit after Passage
li.description: While the Return Passage shield remains active, its original patient can land an ordinary hit on the enemy that triggered it to deal 50 extra soul damage. Once per passage, attributed to the shield author; no other ally or the author can claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: The Way Home
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the passage shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell closer to its original patient, then ordinarily hit a different enemy while within 2 cells to mend up to 20 points of their non-permanent injury. Once per shield. Teleporting cancels it; no eligible wound retains the opportunity without extending it. Scars are excluded. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Keep Watch
li.description: Retains the chosen Guardian evolution. Refinement: retaliation damage or sanctuary shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.

li.label: Brace
li.description: After your shield actually absorbs enemy damage, remember that attacker for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on that enemy deals 50 extra damage once. Trigger cooldown: 4 seconds. Waiting neither changes the target nor renews the window. Reflection, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cover
li.description: An ordinary hit grants a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the other colonist within 3 cells of you who is closest to the victim. That ally must also be within 6 cells of the victim. Cooldown: 5 seconds; no eligible ally spends no cooldown. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Behind the Shield
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Brace deals actual bonus damage, another ordinary hit on the same enemy deals 50 extra damage once. Fresh Brace damage cannot replace an unexpired opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Yield the Edge
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Brace deals actual bonus damage, walk at least one cell away from your position at that trigger and ordinarily hit a different enemy for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Fresh Brace damage cannot reset the round while pending or for 3 seconds after the shield grant. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Call the Target
li.description: When a Cover shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original recipient has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit that attacker for 50 extra damage once, attributed to the shield author. The author and other allies cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cover the Return
li.description: Within 3 seconds after a Cover shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original recipient walks at least one cell closer to the author and ordinarily hits an enemy within 2 cells of the author to mend up to 20 points of their own non-permanent injury, once. Teleporting cancels it; scars are excluded. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Open the Guard
li.description: Actual Behind the Shield damage leaves a 3-second opening on that enemy. The first other colonist to ordinarily hit it deals 50 extra damage attributed to the original author, once. The author cannot claim it; waiting neither changes the victim nor extends the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Cross the Line
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the Yield the Edge shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one further cell and ordinarily hit a different enemy from that attacker for 50 extra damage, once. Teleporting cancels it; later absorption cannot change the attacker or renew the window. A new Yield the Edge shield cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Close In
li.description: After the original ally deals actual Call the Target damage, the author has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit the same enemy and deal 50 damage to the nearest other enemy within 3 cells, once. No second enemy retains the opportunity without extending it. Fresh Call the Target damage cannot replace a pending opportunity. This bonus cannot generate Cover. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Form Up Again
li.description: After Cover the Return actually heals, the author has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit a different enemy and grant the original patient a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. The patient must be within 4 cells and is never replaced. This shield does not trigger Cover branch absorption rewards. Further return healing cannot reset this round while the opportunity or its granted shield remains active. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Press the Breach
li.description: Within 3 seconds after an ally actually claims Open the Guard, your ordinary hit on a different enemy deals 50 extra damage to the original opening victim, once. That victim must remain within 6 cells of you. An unavailable victim retains the opportunity without extending it and is never replaced. Fresh openings cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Shields Together
li.description: Within 3 seconds after an ally actually claims Open the Guard, walk at least one cell closer to that ally and ordinarily hit an enemy while you are within 2 cells of them to grant both of you a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels it; fresh openings cannot replace a pending opportunity. If either old Shields Together layer remains, the opportunity waits without extension. Refinement: each recipient's separate shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Cut Off
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Cross the Line deals actual damage, walk at least one further cell closer to its victim and ordinarily hit it for 50 extra damage, once. Victim movement does not reset your walking origin. Teleporting cancels it. Fresh Cross the Line damage cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Turn Back
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Cross the Line deals actual damage, walk back within 1 cell of the original Yield the Edge position and ordinarily hit an enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 3 cells, once. Teleporting cancels it. Scars are excluded; no patient does not extend the window. Fresh Cross the Line damage cannot replace a pending opportunity or its original Yield the Edge position. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: From Both Sides
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Close In actually damages the secondary victim, the original Call the Target ally can ordinarily hit that victim for 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once. No other pawn can claim it; the bonus cannot trigger Close In again. Fresh Close In damage cannot replace the pending victim, ally or deadline. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Room to Breathe
li.description: Within 3 seconds after Close In actually damages the secondary victim, the author can ordinarily hit a different enemy to grant the original Call the Target ally within 4 cells a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once. This shield cannot trigger Cover rewards and the original ally is never replaced. Fresh Close In damage cannot replace a pending opportunity or an active shield source. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.

li.label: Back to the Front
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the Form Up Again shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original patient takes at least one new walking step and, outside the author’s 2-cell area, hits that attacker with a normal attack for 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once. Teleporting cancels it; later absorption does not renew the window. A fresh shield round cannot replace the original ally or attacker of a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.

li.label: Aid in Reserve
li.description: Within 3 seconds after the Form Up Again shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, the author ordinarily hits a different enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 3 cells of the original patient, once. Excludes the author and original patient. No patient retains the deadline; scars are excluded. Later absorption does not renew it, and a fresh shield round cannot replace the original patient or attacker of a pending opportunity. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.

li.label: Open the Books
li.description: Retains the chosen Wealth awakening. Refinement: silver income. Fractional silver carries over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Trade Dividend
li.description: When cumulative net trade income exceeds its previous peak, earn 5% of the increase as silver. Purchases count as expenses; buying back and reselling cannot pay twice. Fractions carry forward. One colony account persists through negotiator and route changes. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Procurement Fund
li.description: Bank 7.5% of new peak net trade income as procurement credit instead of cash. A later trade with a net silver expense can redeem credit for up to 10% of that expense.
