Fractions and unused credit persist; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Bulk Dispatch
li.description: Each 500 silver of new peak net income earns a freight receipt initially worth 3.4 silver; surplus progress carries forward. A later trade with fresh net income redeems older receipts, while receipts created in that trade wait. Splitting orders creates no extra receipts. Progress and receipts survive route changes, and each receipt keeps its value at creation. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Varied Stock
li.description: Record actually exported goods in trades with fresh net income. Three distinct products complete a docket worth 5% of new net income earned while collecting, initially capped at 5.1 silver. Redeem it by exporting a different product in a later trade with fresh net income. That trade cannot also start another docket. Split stacks count once; dockets and earned value persist through route changes. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Workshop Supplies
li.description: Industrial purchases first reserve procurement credit at 5% of each covered unit's actual price, using at most 50% of net silver expense per trade. Completed recipes that really consume that material initially replenish 50% of the covered quantity. Fractions persist. The account matches quantities by material type, not individual physical stacks. Resale cancels funded units first; hauling and splitting add no quantity. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Household Reserve
li.description: Food and medicine purchases reserve procurement credit at 5% of their actual price, capped at 50% of net silver expense per trade. Actual colonist eating or medicine consumed while tending or operating initially returns 50% of covered units, carrying fractions forward. Quantities are matched by material type; resale cancels registered units first. Hauling, free tending and actions without consumption grant nothing. Surgery must complete its medical-bill processing and consume medicine; its clinical outcome need not be successful, but an exception grants nothing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Rotating Shipments
li.description: When redeeming freight, export a product absent from the trade that created the previous batch to earn an extra 25% of the redeemed freight value. Fresh net income is required. Repeated goods still redeem ordinary freight without the rotation supplement. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Trade Circuit
li.description: Completing a docket opens a 30-day order with that trader, initially worth 50% of the docket. Export goods for fresh net income to another trader, then return and do the same with the original trader. Keep one order at a time. Expired orders pay nothing; a later new docket can open another. Ordinary docket redemption continues. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Supply Relay
li.description: Consuming funded materials in a completed recipe opens one relay worth 25% of that completion's replenishment entitlement, even below one whole item. A different colonist completing a different recipe with actual funded consumption settles the original materials. Keep one relay and carry fractions forward; settling cannot open another in the same completion. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Stock Rotation
li.description: Alternate actual funded food and medicine consumption to gain an extra 25% of the later consumption's household replenishment entitlement. The first use starts the sequence; repeated use of the same category grants no rotation reward. Terms freeze at the preceding category switch. Leaving the branch pauses it; fractions persist. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Freight in Kind
li.description: Convert payable freight and rotation supplements into industrial procurement credit, initially at 750% of their value. Buying materials, components or chemfuel refunds up to 10% of the lesser of eligible goods cost and net silver expense, limited by saved credit. Unused credit persists and pauses outside this branch. Refunds never count as fresh trade income. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Cash Settlement
li.description: New freight receipts settle immediately with an extra 50% of their value. Rotating Shipments still rewards actual different exports. Old receipts settle once at their original value without retroactive settlement premiums. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Joint Orders
li.description: After a circuit settles, its two traders each request a different product from the original docket. Within 30 days, export the requested goods to their respective traders for fresh net income. Completing both earns 100% of that circuit reward. Keep one joint order at a time and retain completed deliveries. The creating trade cannot deliver it; deliveries do not also advance another circuit. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Goods Exchange
li.description: Settling a circuit also banks supply credit worth 500% of its reward. Later purchases of stackable goods can grant more of what was actually bought, valued at the real purchase price and capped at 10% of net silver expense and the quantity purchased. Only whole items are granted. Unused value persists and pauses outside this branch; no extra buttons are needed. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Raw Material Reserve
li.description: Supply relays return an extra 500% of their basic material entitlement, limited to funded materials actually consumed. Components do not qualify. Quantities freeze when the relay opens; fractions carry forward and bonus materials are not automatically funded again. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Precision Spares
li.description: Supply relays also earn industrial component progress worth 375% of their material entitlement, while retaining ordinary replenishment. Convert using base market values when the relay opens and freeze that quantity. Fractions accumulate across orders until a whole component can be delivered; no funded consumption means no progress. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Meal Rotation
li.description: When rotation returns to food, retain ordinary supplies and bank 500% of the rotation reward's nutrition as packaged survival meal progress. Use actual nutrition received, capped at the base nutrition of consumed goods. Fractions persist across rotations and saves; bonus goods are not automatically funded. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Medical Rotation
li.description: When rotation returns to medicine, increase its rotation reimbursement by 500%, returning the funded medicine actually consumed. Fractions accumulate until whole units can be delivered. Injuries, scars, free treatment and treatment counts alone grant nothing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Begin Work
li.description: Retains the chosen Industry awakening. Refinement: production or work benefits. Fractional output carries over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Steady Production
li.description: Completing the same recipe consecutively with actual industrial material consumption returns 10% of those materials. The first completion establishes the previous recipe. Fractions persist by material type in a colony account; changing recipes updates the record. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Flexible Production
li.description: Completing a different recipe from the previous industrial job returns 15% of the materials actually consumed. The first completion only records the recipe; repeating it gives no changeover return. Fractions and recipe history persist across saves. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Measured Stock
li.description: Three consecutive completions of one recipe return an extra 7.5% of actual industrial materials. Each contribution freezes its rate. Successfully completing another recipe resets unfinished progress; bill edits, failed production and duplicate callbacks do not advance it. Fractions persist; leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Batch Settlement
li.description: Three completions of a recipe reserve 10% of each job’s actual industrial materials at its current rate. Later completions of that recipe redeem up to 10% of each matching material consumed. Remaining supplies persist; redemption jobs do not build another batch. Recipes keep separate records across changeovers and pauses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Work Handoff
li.description: Completing production reserves 10% of actual industrial materials for one handoff. Another colonist completing a different recipe with real material consumption redeems it. Terms freeze when opened; neither the same worker nor the same recipe can redeem it. Settlement cannot open another order. Fractions persist; leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Recipe Records
li.description: Complete three different manufacturing recipes to reserve 15% of each job’s actual industrial materials at its current rate. Repeating a recipe adds neither records nor stock. Later production redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed; remaining stock persists. A new collection starts only after all stock is used, and redemption jobs add no records. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Calibrated Work
li.description: Each measured-stock settlement reserves an additional 25% of that return as calibrated supplies, frozen when opened. Later production of the same recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed. Keep one order across recipe changes or leaving the branch; a redemption job cannot open another. Ordinary measured-stock returns remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Circulating Stock
li.description: Completing a batch reserves an additional 25% of its supplies in circulating stock, frozen immediately. Stage-three rewards remain unchanged. Later production of any recipe redeems up to 10% of matching industrial materials actually consumed. Keep one reserve and retain unused amounts; redemption cannot refill it in the same job. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Cooperative Workshop
li.description: Three different colonists each complete a different manufacturing recipe to return an extra 7.5% of each job’s actual industrial materials, frozen per contribution. Repeated workers or recipes do not advance it. Settle after the third job without starting another cycle on that completion. Ordinary two-worker handoffs remain active. Progress persists across saves; leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Recipe Reuse
li.description: Completing a recipe collection reserves an additional 25% of each recipe’s recorded contribution as dedicated supplies, frozen immediately. Later production of that recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed without spending other recipes’ shares. Keep one set until exhausted; redemption cannot open a replacement set in the same job. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Material Recovery
li.description: New calibration orders freeze a recovery rate. Redeeming basic stuff such as steel, wood or cloth returns an extra 500% of the calibrated amount; components and chemfuel do not qualify. Ordinary calibrated supplies remain unchanged. Portions redeemed while this branch is inactive do not receive retroactive recovery. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Precision Work
li.description: New calibration orders freeze conversion rates using material and component base values. Redemption adds components worth 375% of the calibrated supplies without consuming those supplies. Fractional components persist. Portions redeemed while this branch is inactive earn no retroactive conversion, and returns cannot open orders on their own. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Reserve Buffer
li.description: While circulating stock remains, another completed batch may reserve a second allowance at 500% of the normal amount, frozen immediately. Keep at most two and use the older first; the second becomes available on a later job after the first is exhausted. Redemption cannot refill a slot in the same job, and full reserves cannot be overwritten. Leaving this branch freezes the second allowance. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Stock Exchange
li.description: New circulating reserves freeze 375% exchange efficiency. Another recipe may spend currently unused stock for industrial materials it actually consumes. Direct and exchanged returns together cannot exceed 10% of each material consumed. Source base values freeze when reserved; target values freeze on first exchange. Leaving the branch pauses conversion; older reserves gain no retroactive terms. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Return Shift
li.description: Completing three cooperative jobs freezes an extra 75% of all three contributions as return-shift supplies. The original worker redeems them by completing another manufacturing job with real consumption; others cannot claim them. Keep one order, with no replacement order on its redemption job. Ordinary collaboration continues; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Shared Supplies
li.description: Completing three cooperative jobs freezes an extra 100% of each worker’s contribution as their own share. Each worker claims it by repeating their original recipe with real consumption; others cannot claim or spend it. Keep one set with no replacement on a redemption job. Ordinary collaboration continues; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Specialist Recipes
li.description: When Recipe Reuse opens three shares, reserve an extra 100% of the last completed recipe’s dedicated supplies, frozen immediately. Later production of that recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials consumed. Keep one reserve, replenished only after it is exhausted and a new collection completes. Leaving the branch pauses it; ordinary shares remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Diverse Work
li.description: When Recipe Reuse opens a set, record an extra 50% of its materials. Pay after all three dedicated recipe shares are exhausted, in any order; repeating one recipe cannot replace another share. Amounts freeze and only one bonus set is retained. Leaving the branch pauses bonus payment while claims remain recorded; eligible production after returning can settle it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: First Furrow
li.description: Retains the chosen Harvest awakening. Refinement: crop yield or daily supplies. Fractional supplies carry over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Crop Rotation
li.description: Harvest two different edible crops with the same worker within a day to hold one seed record. Their next completed sowing spends it for 15% growth. The record expires after one day. Refinement increases growth; the whole mechanism is available immediately. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Into the Granary
li.description: Each worker banks 15% of their actual edible crop yield. Every third successful harvest pays whole stored produce; fractions and undelivered produce stay in their account. Each contribution keeps the rate at which it was earned. Bonus produce cannot start another batch. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Seed Selection
li.description: When cooking actually consumes food and delivers meals, redeem the cook's existing Separate Stores balance for matching ingredients. The redeemed share of consumed food units, multiplied by 500%, becomes extra meals. Redeemed credit is removed from Separate Stores; moving or splitting food earns nothing. Meal fractions and undelivered rewards persist. Refinement changes only future conversions, not earned meals. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Shared Rows
li.description: When another colonist successfully harvests a food crop you planted, they earn 10% extra growth for their next completed food-crop sowing. Each worker can hold one reward; further harvests cannot stack or replace it. The rate is fixed when the original crop is planted. Retraining this branch clears pending rewards and invalidates earlier planting records. Refinement improves future planting records. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Field Ingredients
li.description: Record food harvested from sown crops for 60 days. Cooking meals with these ingredients earns up to 25% extra meals, scaled by their share of consumed food units. Only actual ingredient consumption and delivered or carried meals count. Fractions and undelivered bonuses remain with the cook, separately for each meal type. Refinement improves future cooking; old credit keeps its value. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Separate Stores
li.description: Successful Granary payouts bank another 125% as worker-owned reserves for that produce. Later harvests of the same produce withdraw whole units, up to 10% of the native yield per harvest (at least one unit). New deposits cannot be withdrawn by the harvest that created them. Fractions and failed deliveries persist; refinement changes only future deposits. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Selective Breeding
li.description: Three successful Seed Selection bonus deliveries of the same crop prepare one selected-seed record for that worker. Each delivered unit stores 3% growth, up to 3% total. Their next completed sowing of that crop spends the record for its stored growth. One ready record per worker and crop; further deliveries wait until it is spent. Refinement improves future contributions, not stored records. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Relay Farming
li.description: After a worker spends a Relay reward to sow a food crop, another colonist can harvest that same plant for 15% extra produce. Sowing alone, ordinary plants and harvesting your own planting do not earn the bonus. The rate is fixed at sowing. Fractions and undelivered produce stay with the harvester and pay out on later harvests of the same product. Refinement improves future cooperative plantings. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Kitchen Shifts
li.description: A homegrown-ingredient cooking completion starts a shift on that map. Within three days, a different colonist must complete another qualifying meal to close it. The pair earns 15% extra meals, weighted by each job's consumed homegrown share, for the second cook. Repeated jobs by the first cook add nothing and do not extend the deadline. Earned fractions and undelivered meals persist; refinement affects only future jobs. Retraining clears unfinished shifts. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Stock Rotation
li.description: When cooking actually consumes food and delivers meals, redeem the cook's existing Separate Stores balance for matching ingredients. The redeemed share of consumed food units, multiplied by 85%, becomes extra meals. Redeemed credit is removed from Separate Stores; moving or splitting food earns nothing. Meal fractions and undelivered rewards persist. Refinement changes only future conversions, not earned meals.

li.label: Stable Variety
li.description: Using selected seeds starts one focused crop cycle for that worker. Three consecutive successful harvests of the planted crop return 10% of their combined native yield. A different crop resets the unfinished sequence. The rate is fixed when the cycle starts; further selected sowings cannot queue or replace it. Fractions and failed deliveries persist after completion. Refinement improves future cycles. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Mixed Breeding
li.description: Complete selected-seed sowings of three different crops with one worker to enrich their next nine successful edible harvests by 25%. Repeated crops do not advance diversity. Each cycle freezes its rate when completed; active cycles cannot stack or bank another cycle. Fractions and undelivered produce persist. Refinement improves future cycles. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Trading Rows
li.description: Complete a cooperative cycle by returning the harvest to its first planter: A plants, B harvests and spends Relay to plant, then A harvests. A gains 5% extra growth on each of their next two food-crop sowings. Pending uses cannot stack, refresh or queue. The rate is frozen when earned; refinement improves future rewards. Retraining clears pending uses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Three Farming Shifts
li.description: Complete a cooperative cycle with three distinct colonists: A plants, B harvests and spends Relay to plant, then C harvests. Each participant gains 7.5% extra growth on their next food-crop sowing. Rewards belong to each worker; pending uses cannot stack or refresh. Rates are fixed when earned. Refinement improves future rewards; retraining clears pending uses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Consecutive Batches
li.description: A completed Kitchen Shift using the same recipe prepares a batch for the receiving cook. Their next three homegrown-ingredient completions of that recipe earn an extra 25% of their actual meal output, weighted by homegrown ingredient share. Another meal recipe clears unfinished progress. Repeated handovers cannot stack or refresh the batch. Its rate is fixed when prepared; fractions and undelivered rewards persist. Retraining clears unfinished batches. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Varied Table
li.description: A completed Kitchen Shift prepares a table for the receiving cook. Afterwards, cook three different meal types using homegrown ingredients to settle a 30% surplus from the first completion of each type, weighted by its homegrown ingredient share. Repeats add nothing; single and bulk recipes for the same meal count as one type. Another handover cannot replace or queue an active table. Its rate is fixed when prepared. Earned fractions persist; retraining clears unfinished tables. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Seeds from Stores
li.description: Finishing an edible crop sowing spends up to one unit of that crop's existing Separate Stores balance, belonging to the sower. Each unit adds 20% initial growth; fractional credit gives proportional growth. Only the amount that can benefit the plant is spent. This uses the same balance as Stock Rotation, so spent seed credit cannot also become meals. Refinement improves future sowings only. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Supplies to Kitchens
li.description: A Stock Rotation conversion opens a three-day supply round on that map. Another cook must spend their own reserves containing a different crop to close it. Each cook earns 125% of their own new converted meal credit as a supplement, fixed at the time of their contribution. The first cook's repetitions and same-crop contributions cannot add value or extend the deadline. Each cook redeems their own completed rewards while cooking. Retraining clears unfinished rounds; earned fractions persist. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.

li.label: Waking Dragonheart
li.description: Advance while wearing Dragonheart. Retains its original six growth stages, wear progress and awakening without granting health, damage, regeneration or execution twice. This tree stops working when the relic is removed; progression stays with the item.

li.label: Pursuing Breath
li.description: Three ordinary hits on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 damage, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Renewing Scales
li.description: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Fully shielded hits, friendly fire and secondary damage do not count. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Ember Nourishment
li.description: After Pursuing Breath actually damages the second enemy, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. No second target or fully prevented breath damage grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Wing Guard
li.description: After Pursuing Breath actually damages the second enemy, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Fangs Beneath New Scales
li.description: After Renewing Scales actually heals an injury, store one retaliation for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 75 bonus damage. Store at most one; taking damage does not automatically retaliate. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Shed-scale Armor
li.description: After Renewing Scales actually heals an injury, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Hits fully absorbed by this shield cannot trigger Renewing Scales again. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Waking Rune
li.description: Retains Runecarver and its original awakening without granting stats or chain levels twice. Later nodes count the current wearer’s effective ordinary hits, excluding secondary damage.

li.label: Forked Inscription
li.description: Every 3 effective ordinary hits deal 50 bonus damage each to up to 2 other enemies within 4 cells and clear sight of the impact. Cooldown: 6 seconds; hits during cooldown do not count. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Piercing Inscription
li.description: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, deal 75 bonus damage. Cooldown: 6 seconds. Changing targets resets the count; hits during cooldown do not count. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Static Mantle
li.description: After Forked Inscription deals damage, gain a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Multiple victims of one fork do not grant extra shields. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Mending Current
li.description: After Forked Inscription deals damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. One heal per fork at most; missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Runic Aftershock
li.description: After Piercing Inscription deals its bonus damage, leave a warning at the impact. After 1.5 seconds, deal 50 damage each to up to 2 enemies within 3 cells and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. Targets can leave the warning area. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Runic Cover
li.description: After Piercing Inscription deals its bonus damage, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. With no ally, it is not redirected to you. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: First Fuse
li.description: Retains Detonation Orb stats and its original detonation without granting them twice. This relic has no original awakening fee. Its wearer may confirm tier one directly; later tiers retain the two-day recovery interval.

li.label: Planted Charge
li.description: Four consecutive ordinary hits on one enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, leave a warning at the impact. After 1.5 seconds, deal 50 damage each to up to 3 enemies within 3 cells and clear sight. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Switching targets resets the count; enemies may leave the warning area. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Skipping Sparks
li.description: Ordinary hits on two different enemies, with no more than 3 seconds between counted hits, deal 50 bonus damage each to up to 2 other enemies within 4 cells and clear sight of the second impact. Cooldown: 6 seconds. Repeated hits on the same target and secondary damage do not add counts. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Blast Core
li.description: After Planted Charge damages an enemy, deal 25 additional damage to its first damaged victim, once per 8 seconds. An empty blast grants nothing; each blast can pay this bonus only once. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Smoke Cover
li.description: After Planted Charge damages an enemy, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no ally, it is not redirected to you. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Ember Follow-up
li.description: Mark the first enemy actually damaged by Skipping Sparks for 5 seconds. One mark at a time, with a 6-second creation cooldown. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Spark Relief
li.description: After Skipping Sparks damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you, once per 6 seconds. One heal per discharge; missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Crown Inheritance
li.description: Advance while wearing the Demon Crown. Keeps its renown, contribution sharing and diminishing returns. Grants neither duplicate base stats nor extra renown. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.

li.label: Changing Fronts
li.description: Three counted ordinary hits, each on a different target from the previous counted hit and no more than 3 seconds apart, deal 50 bonus damage on the third hit, once per 8 seconds. Repeated hits on the same target neither add a count nor extend the window. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Oath of Shelter
li.description: When your shield actually absorbs enemy damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Requires a shield from another source. Does not heal you when no injured ally is available. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Echo of Conquest
li.description: After Changing Fronts actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Breathing Room
li.description: After Changing Fronts actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Does not restore permanent scars or missing parts. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Guarding Decree
li.description: After Oath of Shelter actually heals an ally, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The recipient may differ from the patient. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Answering Blow
li.description: After Oath of Shelter actually heals an ally, store one retaliation for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. A later ordinary hit consumes it for 75 bonus damage. Store at most one; healing itself deals no damage. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Scythe Bearer
li.description: Advance while wearing Reaper's Scythe. Retains its execution, attack intervals and original third-hit effect without granting them twice. Later branches require that original third-hit bonus to deal actual damage; ordinary hits alone and execution alone do not count.

li.label: Scythe Follow-through
li.description: After the original third-hit bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Reaper's Veil
li.description: After the original third-hit bonus deals damage, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Lingering Recovery
li.description: After Scythe Follow-through actually damages its second target, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. No second target or fully prevented follow-through grants nothing. Does not restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Passing Shelter
li.description: After Scythe Follow-through actually damages its second target, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Reckoning Mark
li.description: When any of your shields actually absorbs enemy damage, mark the attacker for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 bonus damage. One mark at a time; granting a shield does not create a mark. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Veiled Aid
li.description: After the original third-hit bonus deals damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Does not heal you if no injured ally is available. Resolves separately from Reaper's Veil. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Reforged Bloodmail
li.description: Retains Bloodforged Armor, its original growth and awakening without granting lifesteal, health or defense twice. Later nodes use ordinary hits and actual healing from this tree; empty healing grants no rewards.

li.label: Living Plates
li.description: While you have recoverable injuries, every 3 effective ordinary hits heal 40 base injury points on yourself, once per 8 seconds. Hits during cooldown or without injuries do not count. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Donor Strike
li.description: Every 3 effective ordinary hits heal 40 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. With no injured ally, retain one completed charge for a later ordinary hit; extra charges cannot be stored. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Sealed Plates
li.description: After Living Plates actually heals an injury, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Original lifesteal and healing from other sources cannot trigger it. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Restored Retaliation
li.description: After Living Plates actually heals an injury, store one retaliation opportunity for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy consumes it for 75 bonus damage. The hit that creates it cannot spend it; at most one is stored. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Donor Shelter
li.description: After Donor Strike actually heals an ally, gain a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Only this tree’s actual injury healing counts; healing a healthy target grants nothing. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Bloodveil Cover
li.description: After Donor Strike actually heals an ally, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The shield selects its recipient independently of the heal. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Tempered Blacksteel
li.description: Advance while wearing Blacksteel Talons. Retains steel growth, diminishing returns, health, defense and awakening without granting duplicate base stats or steel marks. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.

li.label: Scored Reprisal
li.description: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, mark that attacker for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 damage. One mark at a time. Fully shielded hits, friendly fire and secondary damage do not count. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Armored Escort
li.description: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Fully absorbed hits do not count. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Splintered Reprisal
li.description: After Scored Reprisal actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Reforged Recovery
li.description: After Scored Reprisal actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Does not restore permanent scars or missing parts. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Armored Relief
li.description: After an enemy primary hit actually injures you, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects its patient independently from Armored Escort. Does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Armored Advance
li.description: An ordinary hit records your position. Move at least 3 cells and land another ordinary hit within 3 seconds to gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The first hit only records position; later eligible hits update it. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Bound Talisman
li.description: Retains the talisman’s original damage block, recovery, defense and movement without duplicating base stats. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.

li.label: Sheltering Stride
li.description: An ordinary hit records your position. Move at least 3 cells and hit again within 3 seconds to shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The first hit only records position. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Steady Resolve
li.description: Land three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, with at most 3 seconds between hits to heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Switching targets resets the count. Secondary damage does not count; permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Returning Veil
li.description: Under the same movement-and-hit condition as Sheltering Stride, also shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Works without an ally; the two shields resolve independently. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Running Aid
li.description: Under the same movement-and-hit condition as Sheltering Stride, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects independently from the shield and does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Steadfast Seal
li.description: After Steady Resolve actually heals you, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Grants nothing at full health or without recoverable injuries. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Renewed Counter
li.description: After Steady Resolve actually heals you, store one charge of renewal for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy consumes it for 50 damage. One charge maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Healing at full health grants nothing. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Ember Furnace
li.description: Retains original burning, heat aura, health and awakening. New branches count only your original HexBurn pulses that actually damage a standing enemy, not secondary damage or other burn sources. Progression stays with the relic.

li.label: Kindled Flare
li.description: Two consecutive damaging original burn pulses on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 damage, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Furnace Mantle
li.description: Two consecutive damaging original burn pulses on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, grant a 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Fully absorbed pulses do not count. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Reclaimed Heat
li.description: After Kindled Flare actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore permanent scars or missing parts. Prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Flare Shelter
li.description: After Kindled Flare actually deals bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Hearth Aid
li.description: Under the same burn condition as Furnace Mantle, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Counts and resolves independently; does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Banked Ember
li.description: Under the same burn condition as Furnace Mantle, independently store one ember for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 damage. One ember maximum; burn pulses cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Rime Heart
li.description: Retains Frostguard and its original awakening without granting them twice. Every 3 effective ordinary hits grant the current wearer a separate 50-point shield for 4 seconds, on a 6-second cooldown. Hits during cooldown and secondary damage do not count. Progress belongs to this item. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Rime Reprisal
li.description: When a shield actually absorbs an enemy hit, mark that attacker for 6 seconds. Your next ordinary hit consumes the mark for 50 bonus damage. One mark at a time, on a 6-second creation cooldown. Accepts Rime Heart and shields from other sources, excluding this tree's ally-cover shield. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Shared Rime
li.description: When a shield actually absorbs an enemy hit, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. With no ally it is not redirected to you. This tree's ally-cover shield cannot trigger another cover from the same tree. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Splintering Reply
li.description: After Rime Reprisal deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. It never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Rime Mending
li.description: After Rime Reprisal deals bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. Prevented bonus damage grants no healing. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Cooling Aid
li.description: After a shield absorbs an enemy hit, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. Selects its recipient independently of Shared Rime. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Shattering Echo
li.description: After a shield absorbs an enemy hit, leave a warning at the attacker's impact position. After 1.5 seconds it deals 25 damage each to up to 2 enemies within 3 cells and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. The pulse remains at that position. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Riveted Thorns
li.description: Retains original retaliation, health and defense. New branches require original retaliation to actually damage an enemy. Being attacked alone, fully blocked retaliation, friendly fire and secondary hits do not count. Progression stays with the relic.

li.label: Barbed Pursuit
li.description: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, mark it for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 damage. One mark maximum; retaliation itself cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Briar Cover
li.description: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Splintered Barbs
li.description: After Barbed Pursuit actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Briar Stitch
li.description: After Barbed Pursuit actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore permanent scars or missing parts; prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Briar Relief
li.description: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects independently from the shield; does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Gathered Barbs
li.description: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, store one barb for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 damage. One barb maximum; retaliation itself cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Moonweave Stone
li.description: Retains Moonstone’s original group healing, regeneration and awakening without duplicating base stats. Progress stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.

li.label: Mending Thread
li.description: Actually heal the same other colonist three times in succession, no more than 3 seconds apart, to heal 20 additional base points of recoverable injury, once per 8 seconds. The patient must be within 6 cells and clear sight. Changing patients resets the count; full-health attempts and star-generated healing do not count. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Crossed Threads
li.description: Make three actual heals, switching patients each time with no more than 3 seconds between counted heals, to shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 6 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Repeating a patient neither adds a count nor extends the window. Full-health attempts and star-generated healing do not count. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Threadkeeper’s Knot
li.description: After Mending Thread actually adds healing, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Grants nothing if the patient has no recoverable injuries left. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Afterglow Mending
li.description: After Mending Thread actually adds healing, heal 20 base points of recoverable injury on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. This may select the original patient, but never substitutes you. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Returning Thread
li.description: Under Crossed Threads’ alternating-patient condition, also heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from the shield; full health grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Gathered Moonray
li.description: Under Crossed Threads’ alternating-patient condition, store one moonray for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy spends it for 50 damage. One charge maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Healing itself does not launch this attack. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Many-headed Embrace
li.description: Retains this Hydra relic’s original Many Heads or Hunt awakening without granting its bonuses twice. Progress belongs to this item and only its current wearer can use it. Every 3 effective ordinary hits slash up to 2 other enemies within 3.5 cells of the main target for 50 damage each. Four-second cooldown; hits during it do not count. A full charge waits if no secondary target is present. Extra damage does not build charge. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Tooth Marks
li.description: Secondary enemies actually damaged by Many-headed Embrace’s sweep receive a 4-second tooth mark, up to 2 at once. Your next ordinary hit on one spends its mark for 75 slashing damage, with a one-second cooldown per target. A hit cannot spend a mark it just created. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Returning Bite
li.description: Remember the latest Many-headed Embrace’s sweep’s main and tooth-marked secondary targets. Land an ordinary hit on a marked secondary enemy, then hit the original within 4 seconds for 50 extra damage. Once per sweep; a new sweep replaces the record, and either selected victim dying ends it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Following Bite
li.description: After Tooth Marks deals actual bonus damage, slash the nearest other enemy within 3 cells of that victim for 50 damage. Two-second cooldown. This does not trigger Many-headed Embrace’s sweep or Tooth Marks again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Earned Meal
li.description: Enemies actually damaged by Tooth Marks’ bonus strike receive a 4-second feeding mark, up to 2 at once. A later ordinary hit spends that mark to heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Four-second cooldown. Full health keeps the mark; a hit cannot spend a mark it just created. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Closing Jaws
li.description: Completing Returning Bite links its selected victims for 3 seconds. While both live, a later ordinary hit on either adds 50 damage to the other if it is within 3 cells of its recorded position. Each link works once; being out of range neither spends nor extends it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Guarding Jaws
li.description: When Returning Bite deals actual bonus damage, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown. Ordinary damage alone, fully absorbed bonus damage and another wearer’s return strike do not grant this shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Wager Coin
li.description: Retains the coin’s original bounty, critical, movement and awakening effects without duplicating base stats. Progress stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.

li.label: Press the Win
li.description: After an ordinary critical attack actually damages a standing enemy, deal 50 additional damage to it, once per 8 seconds. Skills, secondary damage, allies and downed targets do not count. Adds nothing if the original hit already killed the target. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Hedged Stake
li.description: Count ordinary damaging hits that do not critically strike. Three counts, no more than 3 seconds apart, store one stake for 5 seconds. A later ordinary critical hit spends it for 75 additional damage. Intervening critical hits neither add nor clear counts. One stake maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Skills and secondary damage do not count. Guaranteed critical hits cannot build stakes. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Winnings Guard
li.description: After Press the Win deals actual bonus damage, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Winning Recovery
li.description: After Press the Win deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Does not restore permanent scars or missing parts. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Split Stake
li.description: After Hedged Stake deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again if no other enemy is available. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Shared Winnings
li.description: After Hedged Stake deals actual bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Soul Vessel
li.description: Retains original soul growth, damage, regeneration and awakening. Later nodes require an actual integer soul gain from settled combat contribution. Fractional progress, capped gains and recursive settlement from star-generated damage do not trigger them. They spend no permanent souls; progression stays with the item.

li.label: Lingering Echo
li.description: After actually gaining souls, store one echo for 5 seconds. A later ordinary hit on an enemy spends it for 75 additional damage. One echo maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Gaining several souls at once does not create extra echoes. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Soulbound Veil
li.description: After actually gaining souls, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Several souls gained at once still grant only one shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Divided Echo
li.description: After Lingering Echo deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again if no other enemy is available. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Echo Recovery
li.description: After Lingering Echo deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Prevented bonus damage grants no healing; permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Shared Soul Lantern
li.description: After actually gaining souls, also shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from Soulbound Veil; never substitutes you when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Returning Breath
li.description: After actually gaining souls, also heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from Soulbound Veil; full health grants nothing extra. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Calibrated Ballista
li.description: Retains original damage, sniper, aiming delay and awakening. Later nodes count actual ordinary ranged weapon damage to standing enemies. Explosions, melee, abilities and secondary damage do not count. Progression stays with the item.

li.label: Concentrated Fire
li.description: Two consecutive ranged hits on the same enemy, no more than 5 seconds apart, deal 75 bonus damage, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Mobile Emplacement
li.description: A damaging ranged hit records your position. Move at least 3 cells and land another ranged hit within 5 seconds to shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Expiry records a fresh starting point. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Splinter Bolt

li.description: A damaging blast marks one surviving enemy for 4 seconds. The owner’s next ordinary hit consumes the opening for 75 bonus damage. One opening with a 6-second creation cooldown; skills, allies and mines cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: Flying Shards
li.description: A damaging blast deals 25 bonus damage to another enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. One trigger per blast; the triggering victim cannot be hit again by the bonus. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Wire Cover
li.description: A damaging paired wire strike grants the nearest other colonist within 4 cells of the owner and clear sight a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Unpaired blasts do not trigger it, and there is no self-shield fallback. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Wire Relief
li.description: A damaging paired wire strike heals 2 recoverable injury points on the nearest injured ally within 4 cells of the owner and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. Unpaired blasts do not trigger it. No self-heal, missing-part restoration or scar healing. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Turning Edge
li.description: Retains your learned spin ability. When Spin deals actual damage, slash that victim for 25 extra damage. Three-second shared cooldown across all victims; bonus damage cannot trigger this again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Honed Edge
li.description: Three ordinary hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds leave a blade mark for 4 seconds. A later actual Spin hit consumes it for 50 extra slashing damage. Three-second marking cooldown; only one victim is marked at a time. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Turning Guard
li.description: When Spin deals actual damage, gain a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown; hitting more victims with the same spin does not stack it. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Following Edge
li.description: When Honed Edge deals actual bonus damage, slash the nearest other enemy within 3 cells for 25 damage. Three-second cooldown. This strike cannot trigger Honed Edge or spread again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Renewing Cut
li.description: When Honed Edge deals actual bonus damage, heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Four-second cooldown. Full health produces no healing; fully absorbed bonus damage grants none. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Turning Cover
li.description: When Spin deals actual damage, grant the nearest other colonist within 4 cells a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown. Without an eligible ally it does not trigger or add another shield to you. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Stay in the Fight
li.description: When Spin deals actual damage, heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Six-second cooldown; extra victims in the same spin do not repeat healing. Full health grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Into the Rift
li.description: Requires Blink learned from its augment card. Retains the original range and cooldown. Unlocking this tree neither teaches nor casts Blink.

li.label: Landing Edge
li.description: After successfully casting Blink, store one follow-up for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Store at most one, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Failed casts and other movement do not trigger it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Landing Veil
li.description: After successfully casting Blink, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Failed casts grant no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Rift Sweep
li.description: After Landing Edge deals bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It cannot hit the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Advance Cover
li.description: After Landing Edge deals bonus damage, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Blink Rescue
li.description: After successfully casting Blink, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of your landing and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Healthy allies, missing parts and permanent scars grant no healing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Shared Landing
li.description: After successfully casting Blink, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of your landing and clear sight a 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Hunter’s Trail
li.description: Requires Pursuit Mark learned from its augment card. Retains the original dash, damage, range and cooldown; the tree does not teach the skill for free.

li.label: Tracked Quarry
li.description: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, mark it for 6 seconds. One mark, with an 8-second creation cooldown. When Pursuit Mark actually damages that enemy, consume the mark to refund 10% of this cast’s remaining cooldown, up to 1 second. Switching targets resets the count; secondary damage does not count.

li.label: Hunter’s Guard
li.description: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. A cast that deals no damage grants nothing. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Quarry Recovery
li.description: After Tracked Quarry consumes its mark and refunds cooldown, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Quarry Cover
li.description: After Tracked Quarry consumes its mark and refunds cooldown, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Assault Recovery
li.description: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Covered Assault
li.description: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight a 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally, it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Return Trail
li.description: Requires Return learned from its augment card. Retains the original return point, lifetime, range and cooldown; the tree neither teaches the skill nor creates a return point.

li.label: Retreat Guard
li.description: After successfully casting Return, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Missing return points, failed casts and other movement do not trigger it. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Breathing Room
li.description: After successfully casting Return, heal 40 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored; an uninjured caster receives no healing. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Retreating Edge
li.description: A successful Return stores one counterattack for 5 seconds, at most one, once per 8 seconds. Your next ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage; secondary damage cannot consume or renew it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Return Cover
li.description: After a successful Return, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of the landing and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Shared Recovery
li.description: After Breathing Room actually heals your injury, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. No actual self-healing means no ally healing. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Regained Guard
li.description: After Breathing Room actually heals your injury, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Returning while uninjured cannot trigger this shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Crystal Guidance
li.description: Requires Crystal Bolt learned from its augment card. Retains its original projectile, travel time, damage and cooldown; this tree does not teach the skill.

li.label: Crystal Fork
li.description: After Crystal Bolt actually damages an enemy, strike one other enemy within 4 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 bonus damage, once per 8 seconds. With no other enemy, it does not strike the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Crystal Imprint
li.description: After Crystal Bolt actually damages an enemy, mark it for 6 seconds. One mark, created once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Other targets and secondary damage cannot consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Fork Recovery
li.description: After Crystal Fork actually damages a second enemy, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Crystal Cover
li.description: After Crystal Fork actually damages a second enemy, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Shattered Imprint
li.description: After your Crystal Imprint bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It cannot strike the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Imprint Guard
li.description: After your Crystal Imprint bonus deals damage, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Creating a mark alone grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Aid Rhythm
li.description: Requires Aid Pulse learned from its augment card. Retains original healing, shielding, range and cooldown. Later nodes require actual recoverable injury healing by this skill; its original shield on a healthy target does not trigger them.

li.label: Medic’s Barrier
li.description: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Existing healing and shielding modifiers still apply. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Continued Care
li.description: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. This may be the original patient if still injured; it never selects you. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Medic’s Reprisal
li.description: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, store one reprisal for 5 seconds, at most one, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage; secondary damage cannot retrigger it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Shared Protection
li.description: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Mutual Recovery
li.description: After Continued Care actually heals another colonist, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Without an injured follow-up patient or actual additional healing, nothing triggers. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Caregiver’s Guard
li.description: After Continued Care actually heals another colonist, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The primary skill’s healing alone is not enough. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Suppression Rhythm
li.description: Requires Suppression Pulse learned from its augment card. Retains original damage, stun duration, range and cooldown. Later nodes require this skill to actually increase the target’s remaining stun time; immunity or a stun that does not extend the existing one grants nothing.

li.label: Pinned Opening
li.description: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, mark that enemy for 6 seconds. One mark, created once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that target consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Hitting another enemy does not consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Suppression Barrier
li.description: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Existing shield modifiers still apply. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Opening Burst
li.description: After your Pinned Opening bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It never strikes the original target again and applies no stun. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Opening Recovery
li.description: After your Pinned Opening bonus deals damage, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Suppression Cover
li.description: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Disabling Aid
li.description: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. With no injured ally, it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Drone Call
li.description: Requires Drone Call learned from an augment card. Retains the original summon skill, count and duration; advancement spawns nothing for free. Later nodes accept actual primary attacks by your active drones, echoes and bears, excluding relay projections, secondary damage, friendly fire and downed targets. All summons share the node cooldowns of their owner.

li.label: Pack Opening
li.description: Three consecutive damaging summon attacks on the same enemy, with no more than 3 seconds between hits, mark it for 6 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes the opening for 50 damage. One mark at a time, on a 6-second creation cooldown. Changing targets resets the count; your summons can build it together. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Guarding Instinct
li.description: A damaging attack by your summon grants you a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds across all summons. Spawning or dismissing a summon grants nothing. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Pack Follow-through
li.description: After your Pack Opening bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of that impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. It never hits the original target again and requires the opening to deal actual damage first. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Hunting Recovery
li.description: After your Pack Opening bonus deals damage, heal 20 points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. Prevented bonus damage grants no healing. It cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Guarding Reprisal
li.description: When your shield actually absorbs an enemy hit, mark that attacker for 6 seconds. A later damaging attack by your summon consumes the mark for 50 bonus damage. One mark at a time, on a 6-second creation cooldown. Summon damage cannot create another mark. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Pack Cover
li.description: A damaging summon attack grants the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Guarding Instinct resolves separately. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Mirror Echo
li.description: Requires Mirror Summon learned from its augment. Retains the original summon count, lifetime, limits and recovery. Later nodes accept only primary damaging attacks by your active echoes, excluding drones, bears and relay projections. Echoes share their owner’s cooldowns.

li.label: Feint and Follow
li.description: Your damaging ordinary hit marks the enemy for 4 seconds. One mark, created once per 6 seconds. A later damaging hit by your echo consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Your own attacks cannot consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Reflected Cover
li.description: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. No ally means no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Splintered Edge
li.description: After Feint and Follow deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Returning Echo
li.description: After Feint and Follow deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Twin Reflection
li.description: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, also grant you a separate 1-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Resolves independently of Reflected Cover. Base rewards: shield 25.

li.label: Aid Behind the Mirror
li.description: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, heal 20 base points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. With no injured ally it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Brief Sanctuary
li.description: Requires Group Sanctuary learned from its augment. Retains its 5-cell radius, line of sight, 1-second protection and skill recovery. Later nodes require your own Sanctuary to block an enemy hit; other protection sources do not count. All protected recipients share the caster’s node cooldowns.

li.label: Sanctuary Reprisal
li.description: When your Sanctuary blocks an enemy hit, mark the attacker for 4 seconds. One mark, created once per 6 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.

li.label: Sheltered Recovery
li.description: When your Sanctuary blocks an enemy hit on another colonist, heal 20 base points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. Protecting yourself does not trigger it. With no injured ally it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Reprisal Burst
li.description: After Sanctuary Reprisal deals bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.

li.label: Reprisal Shelter
li.description: After Sanctuary Reprisal deals bonus damage, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Does not extend Sanctuary’s damage prevention. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Recovery Barrier
li.description: After Sheltered Recovery actually heals an injury, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. The shield recipient may differ from the healed colonist. Base rewards: shield 50.

li.label: Shared Recovery
li.description: After Sheltered Recovery actually heals an ally, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. No actual ally healing means no benefit. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.

li.label: Hellbent
li.description: Requires Hellbent. Keeps its 40-hit charge, rescue cooldown and brief protection. Missing organs and permanent scars are not restored. Advancement neither fills the charge nor resets cooldowns. Rescue nodes trigger only after the original card spends its charge and successfully saves you.

li.label: Hold Fast
li.description: A successful Hellbent rescue grants you a separate 150-point shield for 6 seconds. Has a 150-second cooldown and does not change the original rescue cooldown. Base rewards: shield 150.

li.label: Shared Reprieve
li.description: A successful Hellbent rescue shields the nearest other eligible colonist within 6 cells and clear sight for 100 points, lasting 6 seconds. Cooldown: 150 seconds. With no ally, the shield is not redirected to you. Base rewards: shield 100.

li.label: Last Reprisal
li.description: A successful rescue marks its attacker for 10 seconds if that attacker is still a living, standing enemy. Your next ordinary hit consumes the mark for 75 bonus damage. Mark creation cooldown: 150 seconds. Environmental damage creates no mark. Base rewards: damage 75.

li.label: One More Breath
li.description: A successful rescue marks its living, standing enemy attacker for 10 seconds. A later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark to heal 40 points of your recoverable injuries. Without an eligible injury, the mark retains its original expiry. Mark creation cooldown: 150 seconds. Base rewards: healing 40.

li.label: Lift Each Other
li.description: A successful rescue heals 80 points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 6 cells and clear sight. Cooldown: 150 seconds. Does not heal you, missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 80.

li.label: Reprieve Echo
li.description: A successful rescue leaves a warning at your original position. After 1.5 seconds it deals 75 damage to up to 3 enemies within 3 cells and clear sight. Cooldown: 150 seconds. The pulse stays at its original location. Base rewards: damage 75.
